card: In zod 4, z.string().email() and z.string().uuid() are deprecated; use top-level z.email() and z.uuid() instead, passing the same message/params argument.
In zod 4, ZodObject .passthrough() is deprecated; use .loose() on an existing object schema, or z.looseObject() when defining it.
